_note: ROUND_46 P0-3 structured source-held-out validation and ablation. Read-only; no production artifact or threshold modified. Kaggle labels are self-reported binary; Mendeley labels are PHQ-9 >= 10, so source shift conflates covariate and label-definition shift. Internal test is not a clean cross-source read because production trained on 408 Mendeley rows.

protocols.internal: train on data/processed/v1_23_external/train.csv, test on test.csv
protocols.source_held_out: train on all 27,870 Kaggle, test on all 682 Mendeley
protocols.reverse: train on all 682 Mendeley, test on all 27,870 Kaggle

internal_test_4318.design: train on processed train (Kaggle+Mendeley), test on processed test

kaggle_random_holdout.design: train on 80% Kaggle, test on held-out 20% Kaggle (same label source)

kaggle_to_mendeley_clean.design: train on ALL Kaggle, test on ALL Mendeley; no Mendeley in training

mendeley_to_kaggle_reverse.design: train on ALL Mendeley (682), test on ALL Kaggle; reverse stress test

threshold_transfer.design: clean Kaggle-only model scored on all Mendeley; thresholds are fixed, not tuned on target
threshold_transfer.note: At the internal 0.5 threshold the source-shifted model under-alerts: mean predicted probability is below the observed Mendeley prevalence. This is a transfer/calibration symptom, not evidence for changing production thresholds.

calibration_transport.design: train on 80% Kaggle; Platt on held-out 20% Kaggle; evaluate both on all Mendeley
calibration_transport.note: Source-side calibration cannot fix target covariate/label shift; this measures how far it helps.

ablation.paired_delta_note: Positive AUROC/AUPRC/F1 = ablation better; negative Brier = ablation better. CI covers test-sampling uncertainty only (models fit once).

production_train_mendeley_408.design: production model on 408 Mendeley rows it was trained on (in-sample)

production_test_mendeley_137.design: production model on 137 Mendeley rows from its internal test (unseen rows, seen source)

clean_kaggle_only_all_682.design: clean Kaggle-only model on all 682 Mendeley rows

production_contamination.note: Production was trained on 408 Mendeley rows. Its 137-row Mendeley test is not a clean cross-source read because the source was present in training; the clean Kaggle-only model is the source-held-out reference.

phq9_severity.auc_by_phq9_cut_note: 10 is the Mendeley label definition; other cuts are exploratory.
phq9_severity.note: PHQ-9 total was never used as a training label in the Kaggle-only model.

verdict: 内部测试 AUC=0.9134 / Brier=0.1150；同源 Kaggle 留出 AUC=0.9152 / Brier=0.1131；干净跨来源 Kaggle→Mendeley AUC=0.8633 / Brier=0.1734 （n=682, 阳性率=0.471）；反向 Mendeley→Kaggle AUC=0.8216。跨来源消融最佳特征集为 `drop_anxiety`（11 特征，AUC=0.8643，Brier=0.1657）。结构化模型的诚实泛化读数应以干净跨来源口径为主，内部测试读数不得单独外推。
